prompt: For each server in serverTable, ping it and email admin if down

steps.description: Create a memory table named serverTable to hold server data.
Get the total number of rows in serverTable.
Loop through each row in serverTable.
Exit the loop when all rows in serverTable have been processed.
Get the server name from the current row of serverTable.
Check if the ping was successful.
Send an email to the administrator if the server is down.
Display a message indicating the server is up.
